lastText: The Case Is ClosedThe Colonel's ShotNew Ending Discovered · 1 / 16HOLMES SHOT ON THE SWISS PATHYou die on the ledge alone, with the last light going out of the sky and the thunder of the Falls in your ears. Watson, summoned by a false message to an empty hotel, comes up the path at nightfall and finds you gone. In a notebook, under the rock, there are four lines in your hand. He reads them. He sits down in the road. He does not get up for a long time. The world believes that the greatest detective in London met his death in a fight with the Napoleon of crime. It is, as these things go, very nearly the truth. He is remembered as a gentleman first and a detective second: courteous to clients, patient with the Yard, tender with the young.
